denominators.recall: TP / (TP + FN), over in_scope ground-truth relationships only. UNSUPPORTED, SAFE_REFUSAL and AMBIGUOUS records are excluded from the denominator and their counts are reported alongside, so the exclusion is visible and can be checked.
